description: Deterministic, non-sensitive Phase 3 native PDF extraction and trust-gate fixtures. Regenerate with fixtures/synthetic/native/generate_native.py.

fixtures.note: One page of paragraphs, digits, punctuation, accented Latin text, table-like columns, and multiple built-in fonts/sizes.
Three pages of good native text.
Good native page whose CropBox is inset from its MediaBox.
Full-page PNG image only; no PDF text-drawing operators.
Page 1 has good native text; page 2 is a full-page image only.
Raw ToUnicode CMap emits U+FFFD replacement characters.
Raw ToUnicode CMap emits private-use codepoints U+E001 and U+E002.
Raw ToUnicode CMap emits C0 control characters U+0001 and U+0002.
Identical text is drawn 50 times at the same coordinates.
Two text lines are placed outside page bounds; one visible anchor remains.
Raw text matrices with zero text scale and negative horizontal scale approximate zero-size and inverted boxes.
